1.
Supplementary affidavit, filed in Court today, is taken on record.
2. Heard learned counsel for the revisionist and learned AGA for the State.
None is present on behalf of opposite party No.2-first informant despite service of notice.

3. The present criminal revision has been filed by the revisionist-Krishna Singh Alias Kishan against the impugned order dated 3.7.2025 passed by the Special Judge (POCSO Act)/Additional Sessions Judge, Kushinagar at Padrauna rejecting the revisionist's discharge application filed under Section 227 Cr.P.C. in Special Session Trial No.909 of 2022 (State vs. Krishna Singh alias Kishan) arising out of Case Crime No.67 of 2022 under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC, Sections 3/4 POCSO Act, 2012 and Section 3 (2)(v) SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989, Police Station-Ahirauli Bazar,
District-Kushinagar.

sentences.text: 4. Brief facts of the case are that the alleged offence is dated 14.2.2022.
The FIR was registered on 1.4.2022 by Smt.Madhuri Devi against sole accused Krishna Singh Alias Kishan (revisionist).
She alleges that her minor daughter/victim aged about 17 years was eloped and kidnapped on 14.2.2022 around 2:00 p.m. by the accused-revisionist Krishna Singh.

5. The learned counsel for the revisionist has submitted that the impugned order is illegal and without application of the judicial mind; the FIR is frivolous and with malice intention, it has been registered.

He further submitted that victim is major, whose marriage was solemnized on 11.12.2021 in a 'Camp organized under 'Chief Minister Group Marriage Scheme' where the victim has been shown to be 20 years; no case has been made out against the revisionist; the revisionist is entitled to be discharged and his criminal revision is entitled to be allowed.
6.

Per contra, learned AGA for the State has submitted that the victim is a minor-girl; the charge-sheet is filed against the sole-accused after thorough investigation; the criminal revision is liable to be dismissed.

7. In the said matter, after detailed investigation, the charge-sheet has been filed under Section 363,
366, 376 IPC, Sections 3/4 POCSO Act, 2012 and Section 3 (2)(v) SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities)
Act, 1989 against the sole accused-revisionist.
The learned trial court has observed that any certificate regarding age at the time of 'community-marriage' does not possess any legal significance.
8. In the FIR, the age of the victim is stated as 17 years by the mother of the victim, who is complainant.
The statement of Smt.Madhuri under Section 161 Cr.P.C. where she supported the incident and further reiterated, the age of victim is 17 years.
The statement of the victim is recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C.
At the time of recording the statement of the victim, she stated that she is 18 years old and I had gone to Delhi with Krishna Singh, six months ago.
As per this statement, at the time of offence, she was less than 18 years.
The statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C. was recorded on 28.9.2022.
The statement of the victim was also recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.

entities.text: She Krishna Singh Alias Kishan vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 9. As per Chief Medical Officer, Kushinagar, report dated 3.10.2022, the age of the victim is below 18 years.
The victim appears to be minor, less than 18 years of age.
10. The reasoned by learned trial court does not possess any illegality or irregularity.

There is no illegality in the order 3.7.2025 passed by the Special Judge (POCSO Act)/Additional Sessions Judge,
Kushinagar at Padrauna rejecting the revisionist's discharge application filed under Section 227 Cr.P.C. in Special Session Trial No.909 of 2022 (State vs. Krishna Singh alias Kishan) arising out of Case Crime No.67 of 2022 under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC, Sections 3/4 POCSO Act, 2012 and Section 3 (2)(v) SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989.
